name: Button
description: A button in six weights and three sizes, with icons and a pending state.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual weight. Primary is ink for the main action, brand is water.

props.name: iconStart
props.description: Icon before the label. Sized to 16 pixels.

props.name: isPending
props.description: Shows a spinner in place of the start icon (or over the label when there is none), keeps the width, sets aria-busy and blocks presses.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Called when the button is pressed by mouse, touch or keyboard.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged with cn(). Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Button.
